notes.title: Steam Winter Sale and 2023 Update!
notes.content:
Hey gang!

First things first: we're sorry for the radio silence these past few months. We know you've had lots of questions on achievements - like, when will they work? - and when you can expect the next chapter, but we've had to dial our production schedule back. Unfortunately I've been really, really sick, and Ross and I decided the next thing to do was for me to focus on getting better. I'm still going through that process, but we have every intention of upping our game in 2023. And yes, that includes fixing Steam achievements and getting the comic Deck verified. These are our priorities outside of making more issues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26319859/7adb9e9ea7c187398d4af71f3259c28374597a11.png

Right now, though, it's the Steam Winter Sale, and we've discounted every chapter! Although the year has been slow, we're super pleased with our release of Chapter 8 - Remnant, which we honestly think is our best chapter yet. If you haven't checked it out yet, it's on sale right now.

We hope you've all had a wonderful year and wish you the very best for the next one. Merry Christmas, too, ya filthy animals.

Mike and Ross

notes.title: Interlude 7.5 - Castle Okno Released!
notes.content:
Hey all,

We’re very proud to announce the release of Interlude 7.5 – Castle Okno! It’s eight pages in length and, as is our custom with the interludes, totally free: just boot up the app or check your Steam directory for the PDF.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26319859/65ec577307a5915ee03c891ff0c08580460081a0.jpg

What’s it about?

Over a year before Leyla and Dreyfus arrive in North America, they infiltrate a Combine weather station in Eastern Europe - Castle Okno - on a secret mission.

It’s brought to you by Ross Joseph Gardner, Michael Pelletier, Kristian Rossi, Ester Salguero, and DC Hopkins.

What’s up next? 

Well, that'd be Chapter 8 - Remnant. Unfortunately the ongoing pandemic has contributed to our efforts being slowed somewhat, but we're excited to kick into gear with it in the new year. Chapter 8 contains some big revelations. 

We will also have more changes coming! We're going to prioritize reworking the images and PDFs to be a higher quality without hopefully cutting into file size too much. Special thanks to monad for his continued assistance in that regard. Russian translations are still in the works, but we have no update on that front. Separately, our friend Artur Neufeld has also been working tirelessly on a German translation! He has the first 4.5 chapters translated, but there's still a little bit left to do on them before release. Here's an early sneak peek. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26319859/a4ae42bbfa4545c0efdc36842ee55a3cc5016e07.png

In the meantime, check out 7.5 and tell us what you think! Speak soon.

Mike and Ross

We're also on the cusp of releasing interlude 7.5 - Castle Okno. It's an 8-page story that details a key event in Leyla's past. As a teaser, here's the first page.

notes.title: Anniversary Sale and Update!
notes.content:
Hello gang,

We hope you’ve had a stellar summer. As we head into autumn, we thought we’d give you an update on where we’re at and what to expect for the rest of the year.

We want to first take a moment to celebrate our five year anniversary of being on Steam! It's a huge milestone for us - Five years ago, Ross and I were huddled around a laptop together in Boston, pushing out the first build of the app, and preparing for the Steam Dev Days conference in Seattle. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26319859/5b215b43ec65c62573d820d3fbdd3730a5e19d3f.png

A whole lot has changed in the world since then, and that’s true of us, too. Five chapters, two remakes, several interludes – it’s a lot of pages, and puts us squarely at the halfway point in our story. We’d prefer not to take another five years wrapping things up, but comics are an expensive business.

Which brings us to the remainder of 2021. Whilst our original plan was to have Chapter 8: Remnant well into production by now, it sadly wasn’t an affordable prospect. At present, Interlude 7.5: Castle Okno is partway through its production cycle, and will be released before the end of the year, with Remnant firing up in early 2022.

In accordance with the big anniversary, we’ve discounted all chapters and both volumes of the soundtrack by a whopping 75%. The sale will run for the duration of the day, so if you haven’t checked out the later chapters, now is a great time to do so!

We’ll see you in a few weeks. Thanks for sticking with us!

Mike and Ross

notes.title: Chapter 7 Update (and a new Discord server!)
notes.content:
Hey gang,

We just thought we’d give you a quick update since it has been a bit. 

We’re about to hit the halfway mark on Chapter 7: The Dark Between the Stars, which puts us in a comfortable position to release sometime in June. At 38 pages it’s a larger chapter than most, but that’s befitting the scope of the story. It puts us at the midway point in our comic, so it’s a big deal for us! We’re very excited as to how it’s coming together and the team are doing a stellar job.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26319859/25c6825a0fcfeeff084d06861da4c56686d7b80b.png

We have also launched a Discord server for the comic. If you’d like to chat to us, tell us what we’re doing wrong, or have suggestions for the app, come on over! We’d love to hear what you have to say. Beyond that, you’ll find a very pleasant and amiable community of Half-Life fans.

Join our Discord!

That’s it from us for the time being. We hope you’ve enjoyed the remakes and are looking forward to the future of A Place in the West. There are some big surprises in store…

Mike and Ross

notes.title: Steam Summer Sale and Update on the Remakes!
notes.content:
Hey gang,

Just a quick update from us as we head into the summer. As ever we hope you’re all keeping safe and well.

As you know, the bulk of our efforts this year have been spent remaking Chapters 1, 1.5, 2, and 2.5. Right now we’re approaching the halfway point in Chapter 2’s production, which like its progenitor is quite a bit larger than our standard chapters – it’s 48 pages in total! But we couldn’t be happier with how it’s coming together and we hope to be able to share it with you later this year. The team are doing an amazing job.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26319859/97a960c95110f419cdac5fd93e5a246b857f3ae2.png

The Steam Summer Sale has just kicked off, which means Chapters 2 – 6, plus the soundtracks, are all on sale. We hope you take the opportunity to check them out. Again, if you’ve already purchased Chapter 2 or intend to purchase it before the remake is released, you’ll receive the remake for no additional cost. And, of course, Chapters 1, 1.5, and 2.5 will remain free.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26319859/41ac546539df05b92115c4f9dee2c3540135e8db.png

And then, once that’s done, it’s straight on to the end, starting with 6.5 and then Chapter 7: The Dark Between the Stars… More on those to come.

Mike and Ross

notes.title: Quick Technical Update
notes.content:
Hey gang,

I just wanted to give a quick update on a couple tech things that have come up within the last few days!

As you may have seen already, MacOS Catalina has come out and dropped support for 32-bit mac applications. There are also some other changes under the hood where apps require Signing, now, which is why A Place in the West is currently listed as incompatible with Catalina - we have a 64-bit mac build, just not the signing.

I updated my mac to start testing my fix for this, and in doing so, unexpectedly ruined my ability to build the application for other operating systems. Our current build process uses Wine to create the executables for Windows and Linux, and Wine - as a 32-bit program - is not compatible with Catalina. And, of course, this came up at the same time as a bug where one of the achievements is not accessible.

SO, here's the plan.

1. I'm going to set up a different mac with the ability to compile the app, and get out a fix for the achievement, ideally on Saturday.
2. Once that is dealt with, I am going to fast-track an app rewrite that I've been planning for a while. The bulk of what we have I wrote 3 years ago(!) and I can make improvements across the board.
3. Once that is all resolved, I'll turn my attention back to a proper fix for Catalina. 

I would like to also take this opportunity to remind everyone that A Place in the West installs do come with the PDFs for each chapter in your Steam Apps / A Place in the West directory. 

If you are someone who uses Catalina and are outraged at this process of events, please do let me know! I am not sure how many people have actually upgraded. And please feel free to reach out if you have any questions, and I very much appreciate your patience during this time.

Best,

Michael

[EDIT]
Update Nov 2nd: The issue with the achievement should now be fixed!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26319859/2597b5c21c2722aef705dba008a92c07ef997862.jpg

With the execution of the Governor at the hands of Major-General Long, New Franklin is poised on the brink of chaos. Colonel White, Long’s second-in-command, launches a devastating assault on the Opposition base in an attempt to capture the vortigaunt Dreyfus. In response, the leader of the Opposition, Sejal Rajani, lays the groundwork for a counterattack against City Hall, but faces unexpected resistance from Leonard Banks, the power plant foreman, who is harboring a dangerous agenda of his own.

And in a secret prison beneath City Hall, Leyla Poirier meets Long’s captive son, Kurt, and learns the dark truth about her journey to America.

notes.title: Containment Release!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Happy 20 Years of Half-Life!

As announced this past weekend, today we are releasing another content pack for A Place in the West! The app has been updated to include the Russian Translation of Chapter 5 (Thanks to Vsevolod Stepanov and Pavel Lapinsky), as well as adding “Containment”, our new interlude that takes us back to Black Mesa, to the place where it all began.

There’s also a new Extra involving “Containment”, for which we give thanks to Rikki "Marphy Black" D'Angelo, that I’ll let you explore for yourself… “Containment” and the Chapter 5 Russian translation are both available in PDF form as well. Finally, we’re releasing Volume 2 of our soundtrack today, with 9 new tracks from Chris Jolley! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26319859/de101bfda39daf522292488ddf495f952366f512.png

Celebrating Half-Life
This past weekend we did a Twitch Stream, where Ross played through Half-Life and we laughed at how many times he died (it was a LOT). If you didn’t catch it and are interested, it’s still available on Twitch until it expires -  http://twitch.tv/halflifecomic. I will also be uploading the original to our YouTube channel, as well as cutting together a shorter “Highlights” reel for someone who wants to laugh at Ross’s deaths, and hear us talk about the comic, but not sit through 6 hours of gameplay. 

We’re talking about going through Opposing Force and Blue Shift next, followed by Half-Life 2 and both of its Episodes, so if this is something that you like or would like to see more of, please do let us know! And thank you to everyone who came to hang out and chat, it was a lot of fun. 

Speaking of celebrating Half-Life, Digg.com did a write-up about the 20th Anniversary, and Ross and I both talked a bit about our experiences with the franchise. You can read that here - http://digg.com/2018/half-life-20th-anniversary

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26319859/1ad6a1a20873125f63f778854d59e30c7d4b991f.jpg

What's Next?
So many things. 

Since it’s the end of the year and we haven’t been as transparent during the course of it as I’d have liked us to have been, let’s take full stock, shall we?


 Chapter 6 is going into Production in December! We weren’t able to produce nearly as much this year as I would have liked because of financial reasons, and it’s great to be getting back to it. My hope is that we can have multiple chapters release next year.

 We’ve also been working on getting everything down on paper. Often when we’re producing, we have the next chapter or two written, but now we’re extending our lens further. Ross has been hard at work over the last few months forging ahead into the later chapters. As production is approaching the story’s halfway point(!), we’re spending a lot of time looking at wrapping up threads and character arcs. Currently we have up through Chapter 11 written (at least as rough drafts), with the plan being to finish the remaining chapters by the end of the year. 

 Over the next month, I have some homework to do myself: I’m going to rewrite the APW App to try and solve the Windows 10 problems that have been plaguing us for quite some time. I’m also going to be getting back into the world of video editing - cutting the Stream Highlights video together for YouTube and getting back into making the Commentary Tracks. We have commentary audio for Chapters 2, 3, and 4 recorded, and the audio mixing for all of them nearly done, I just need to finish the videos themselves (and add subtitles, which was a popular request with the last Commentary video).

 Finally, Translations! These are something that I really dropped the ball on this year. We have translations for Chapter 2 that have been sitting around (largely due to financial strains) so the plan will be to get those lettered and shipped out, and then to do more prep with the published chapters and try to get the translators to help us out some more. I don’t want to make any promises about how much will or won’t be done, but I am going to make it much more of a priority than I have so far. Stay tuned for hearing more about that in early 2019.


As ever, making Half-Life: A Place in the West is an experience that we are endlessly grateful for, and wish to say thank you to everyone who has been with us on the journey so far, and to everyone new who is joining us along the way. I am so excited to share with you all of the exciting things we have in store for the next year.

notes.title: Summer Sale & Chapter 5 Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26319859/81667c4d34f2ad655f356eba0ca5bfb4c0742cd0.jpg

Hey gang!

We just wanted to drop a line on where we’re at right now with the comic, and what you can expect over the course of the next few months.

As most of you no doubt know, the Steam Summer Sale is in full swing, so we have accordingly discounted our entire library – Chapters 3, 4 and the Soundtrack are available at 25% of their regular price, with Chapter 2 reduced by 50%!

If you haven’t already caught up with the comic, now is a great time to do so: Chapter 5, "The Eyes of the People" is scheduled for a July release. We’re very excited about this one – the artists have outdone themselves – and can’t wait to share it with you all. It wraps up a few of the arcs kicked off in Chapter 3 and represents a significant turning point in the story.

So what’s it about?

It’s the night of New Franklin’s annual masquerade banquet, and the city’s political rivals vie for dominance amongst a blind and debauched populace seeking shelter from a wicked blizzard. Governor Moore, aiming to install himself as the city’s leader, plots to assassinate Major General Long at the evening’s end, whilst Long himself prepares to move against Sejal Rajani’s Opposition in an effort to apprehend the vortigaunt Dreyfus.

And on the fringes of the city, away from the lights of the masquerade, Albert Kempinski takes matters into his own hands to find his kidnapped daughter – with disastrous results…

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26319859/26e464ec889ad7d08b1f1cf3714a0dc27ccbf005.jpg

As for our plans for the rest of the year, you can expect a new interlude, as well as for production to begin on Chapter 6, sometime in the fall. There may be some more Surprises coming, too.

In the meantime, enjoy the sale, and keep an eye out for Chapter 5 in the next few weeks!

Ross and Mike

notes.title: Chapter #4 - "A Spy in the House of Long" Released!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26319859/f6d24ffa05f5f8780f8e43b3d6846f8cca9a09a6.png

Hey gang,

We're very excited to announce the release of Chapter 4 of our fan-made Half-Life comic, A Place in the West. Once again coming in at a total of 30 pages, Chapter 4 – titled A Spy in the House of Long – picks up immediately after the events of the third chapter. The fallout from the Pit disaster spreads throughout the city, bringing its competing factions into conflict. Fearing a loss of power, Governor Moore acts to quell Sejal Rajani's Opposition - a group of dissenters with a radical plan for the city's future - forcing Major-General Long to resort to extreme measures to reassert control.

Chapter 4 was created by the same art team that delivered The Pit – Kristian Rossi (pencils), Ivan Miranda (inks), Ester Salguero (colours) and Javier Puga (letters) – and features some of the most visually arresting scenes from the comic so far. We couldn't be happier with the finished product, and we're convinced it's the best yet. 

Hopefully you will, too.

What's next?

The script for Chapter 5 – titled The Eyes of the People – has been completed and is undergoing a few final adjustments before going into production early next year. It marks the end of the present, 3-chapter arc ("Masquerade" as we call it), and brings some of the current storylines to what we hope is a pretty dramatic conclusion!

Of course, before you get to see that we'll be delivering the third interlude (small, 3-5 page shorts released for free) somewhere within January/February. We're really eager to get this one into your hands – it's similarly cosmic in setting as Nal Sidian was, but unlike that piece of Dreyfus' backstory, it really gets the narrative's wheels moving, and delivers something of a game-changer. More on that (and other things) in the new year...

In the meantime, please do enjoy Chapter 4, and, as ever, let us know what you think!

Ross and Mike

notes.title: The Tale of Nal Sidian
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26319859/78f6befa906194904a7741423723debda36ae934.png

Hey all!

Today marks the one year anniversary of our initial release on Steam! 

To celebrate it, we’ve released a brand new interlude - formerly known as “shorts” - for free! Titled Nal Sidian, this five-page story delves into the vortigaunt Dreyfus’ past, and explores his relationship to the nefarious Combine. Our plan is to release a free interlude between every chapter going forward. Now integrated into the app’s chapter selection menu, these pieces are very much fundamental to the complete story.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26319859/038ccb15357932257b5ff47bba095d082b3811ff.jpg

Speaking of the app, this update also introduces some much needed tweaks and updates! We now have improved language support, and we’ve released Chapter 1 and the first interlude (The Charnel House) for the new languages as well! You can now read through the first section of the comic in Czech, German, Spanish, and Turkish! We will be bringing these languages to Chapters 2, 3, and Nal Sidian in the coming months, as well as continuing to add more languages to our selection. Brazilian Portuguese is next and should be out within a few weeks, with more to come! 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26319859/892b83373a66e81cd55df999ae7e1eb61850799f.jpg

The translations took us a bit longer to get out the door than we’d have liked, largely because we no longer had the original files for Chapter 1 and had to reletter it, as well as the looming size of Chapter 2. Our original plan was not to release the language updates incrementally, but we feel it’s important for our superb team of volunteer translators to see their work on the page! We’ll be forging ahead with the monster that is Chapter 2, and working towards a point where we’re releasing new chapters simultaneously (or at least nearly simultaneously) across all of our supported languages. 

The app also now includes integration with our soundtrack, so that you can easily listen to Chris’s ambient tunes while reading. We have a few other features in the pipeline (including controller support) and there will be more updates to come on the app soon as well! 

What about Chapter 4?

We’re well over halfway through production on Chapter 4: A Spy in the House of Long, and we could not be more excited about how it’s coming together. Taking place directly after the Pit debacle, 4 sees Sejal Rajani’s Opposition, Governor Moore and Major-General Long come head-to-head in a dramatic confrontation on the edge of the city, whilst shedding new light on the Citadel and the mysterious being wrapped around it. 

We have always suffered from being slow storytellers, and we’ve been very aware of that over the last several months. With that in mind, Chapter 4 really digs deep into New Franklin and applies pressure to the different groups competing for power. 

It’s visually stunning, too. The team - which brings back Kristian, Ivan, Ester and Javier - are operating at the top of their game, and between them have created a gorgeous, moody, almost noir-like atmosphere for what’s shaping up to be the best chapter yet. We’re super excited about it, and can’t wait to share it with you all.

notes.title: Chapter #3: “The Pit” Released!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26319859/ae6e99f1d2883ce8debd57c77cd88310a2b4c7c8.jpg

Hi everyone!

Chapter 3 of the fan-made comic Half-Life: A Place in the West is now available! Titled “The Pit”, this chapter comes in at 30 pages. The Pit picks up where Chapter 2 left off: Leyla Poirier and Albert Kempinski go their separate ways after an intense dispute, but are both drawn to a gladiatorial arena in New Franklin. Known as “Kal’s Pit”, this seedy arena puts on a show of blood sport against captured aliens from beyond the city’s walls. But when an accident throws everyone into danger, an unlikely hero emerges… And back at City Hall, Major-General Long makes a discovery that will change New Franklin forever.

We’ve made some changes in our team with this issue - Ivan, Ester, and Javier have continued on from Chapter 2 in the roles of Inker, Colourist, and Letterer, respectively, but our previous penciler, Heath, has had to step down due to family commitments - we will miss him, and are incredibly grateful for the wonderful work he did on Chapters 1 and 2. In his place, we’ve brought on Kristian Rossi, who has worked on such comics as Trespasser, The Temporal, and Moonshine. Kristian brings his own style, and we think you’ll love the new direction. As always, let us know your thoughts!

What’s Next?

Sometime Soon (tm) we’ll be doing another application update. This will come before the release of Chapter 4, and will contain another (free!) short interlude between chapters, as well as application improvements including controller support, integration with our soundtrack, and possibly the fabled addition of opting into a two-page layout. This will also include the behind the scenes commentary video for Chapter 2, which I am still cutting together.

We also should be shipping the first batch of our additional translations at that time! As well as the translation of Chapter 3 into Russian, which is unfortunately not yet ready for release today. (Obviously if that’s ready before the release, we’ll do our best to get it out ahead of time!)

We’re also working hard on Chapter 4, which will be going into production the first week of August, and an intended release this autumn. More coming on that soon. 

What else is going on?

To plug some other things, Ross and I have been writing Blog posts on the new A Place in the West website, on topics from artistic style, comics on Steam, and why we decided to use the Half-Life IP. You can check those out at http://a-place-in-the-west.ghost.io/. Our website also contains a newsletter signup if you want more frequent updates that we generally post here on Steam. The newsletter comes out once a month and contains some additional behind-the-scenes looks and early teases.

Ross and I were also interviewed for the Ghost City Comics podcast which should be released early next week. Be sure to check them out! Their podcast is very informative and, if you are (or want to be) a comic creator, they are doing a competition which can get you feedback, reviews, and even a cash prize.

As ever, we thank you for continued interest and support of the comic, and hope you’re looking forward to sticking with us through the Pit and beyond!

notes.title: Expansion in the West
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26319859/a74e6f13876d8ca55f10a567e6877e2ed297ad68.png

Hey everyone,

We hope that you’ve enjoyed Issue 2! We're very excited to announce that as part of the build being released on Monday, we'll have the Russian translations for Issue 2 available! We also want to take this time to share some more updates on our end, most notably about Issue 3 progress. But first, some extra things we’ve been working on...

New Website
I’ve redesigned our website to be considerably more than a landing page. We’re going to start using it to open up our production process in the form of blog posts. These will be on everything from creating comics, to the Half-Life universe itself, to the nature of storytelling, and anything else we feel like. Perhaps even topics suggested by readers! We’re launching with 3: “Why a Half-Life Comic”, “On Hiring and Style”, and "A New Kind of Protagonist". We'll be writing and posting more over time, so let us know what you think of them!

Additionally, the website has a newsletter that you can sign up for if you’d like more regular updates from us. The newsletter will be sort of an added bonus for those interested. It is not quite the frequent and small updates of twitter and not quite the large announcements of the Steam page. The idea is to release one every month that goes more into detail about how things are progressing, as well as what things Ross and I are reading or watching to draw inspiration from. It may include behind the scenes looks as well! 

If you’re interested, you can see our blog posts and sign up for the newsletter at http://www.aplaceinthewest.net/. 

Soundtrack
Also launching on Monday will be an official A Place in the West soundtrack. This DLC will feature 6 tracks created specifically for us by Chris Jolley. He’s the only person aside from Ross and myself who knows what’s coming in future issues, and he has used that knowledge to create some very compelling and exciting music. Chris has been doing audio work for us for a while, and created both the Ubdisha sounds and music you can hear in the background of the application. If you like his stuff and want to support him, give it a buy! The soundtrack will cost $2.99. 

Issue 2 Commentary Track
During the second week of May we’ll be recording our Commentary Track for Issue 2! 

If you haven’t checked out the Commentary Track for Issue 1, I’d recommend it. It’s sort of a “Director’s Commentary” from myself and Ross about where A Place in the West came from, and the creation of Issue 1. It includes a behind the scenes look with some WIP artwork and script pages, and we talk pretty candidly about some of what we did wrong. 

For Issue 2’s commentary we’re doing something a little different, and the entire art team will also be involved! As with Issue 1’s commentary, this will be released as separate and free DLC - an extra for those who are interested in the process.

As part of this, we’ll be doing a Q&A segment, so if you have questions for the team, please do send them our way, either here on the Steam post, on Twitter, or via email. They don’t have to be just directed at myself and Ross - feel free to ask anyone on the art team about their process or inspirations or anything you’d like!

The video itself will take some time to cut together, but I’m hoping to release it sometime in early June.

Issue 3 Status
And now for what you’re most interested in, this week we’re starting with production on Issue 3! In fact, by the time you read this, we’ll have already begun.

Our previous penciler, Heath, has had to step off the project and finding a talented replacement took longer than we’d hoped, but it was worth it. We’re pleased to announce that our new penciler is Kristian Rossi. Kristian has worked in the comics industry for years, as the sole artist on Trespasser and as the colourist on Moonshine, published by Image Comics. We’re incredibly happy to have him joining us, and think you will be, too. 

Issue 3 is still slated to be released in late Summer!

notes.title: Chapter #2: A Very Modern Major-General Released!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26319859/ddcd0c827c40a59d11e90642570ab87dc0c93b98.png

Hi everyone,

We are incredibly excited to release the second chapter of the fan-made comic Half-Life: A Place in the West, titled “A Very Modern Major-General” today as DLC. We sincerely apologise to readers for the unexpected delay last month, but at the 11th hour we were taken by surprise when Valve granted us use of the Half-Life license. This means that, starting with the second chapter, A Place in the West will now move into a paid DLC model. 

The hopefully minimal price tag is intended to alleviate our production costs - for further elaboration on this point, do scroll down. We cover it quite extensively! We’d like to thank Valve for the opportunity, and we hope our readers will embrace the change, too.

We have also made the first 5 pages of Chapter #2 available for free as a teaser. The app will automatically update to make those accessible.

"A Very Modern Major-General" picks up where the first chapter left off - we rejoin Leyla Poirier, Albert Kempinski and the vortigaunt Dreyfus as they enter the strange city of New Franklin. Introducing a host of new characters and fresh intrigues, this chapter comes in at 50 pages and includes 5 new achievements!

The second chapter has been the result of a year of work, and has involved several changes to our team. Our artist from Chapter #1, Heath Heil, has stepped back to focus on raising his daughter. While Heath still did the penciling for chapter #2, he was also joined in this chapter by Ivan Miranda on inking, Ester Salguero on colouring, and Javier Puga for lettering. We also had the pleasure of working with Jiedi Chen and Daniel Gerhard last summer on some additional art which makes its appearance in this chapter. 

So, please, go and read it, and as always, let us know what you think. 

What are we working on now?

I’m continuing to champion our work on translating the comic and working with some very talented people to make the comic available in more languages. Because of the amount we are translating (80+ pages!), we unfortunately don’t have anything to release quite yet, but I can assure you that we’re working on getting these updates prepared. We still have a considerable amount of lettering to do, but my hope is that by early Summer we’ll have at least the following languages released: Brazillian Portuguese, Czech, Turkish, Spanish, and of course the Chapter #2 updates for Russian.

This is not by any means all of the languages we’re working on - we have others which are in varying states of completion. This also does not mean that we are not still looking for more people to help out. Many of the languages we’re hoping to support only have one person working on the translations and it’s very difficult to do since there is both a lot to be done and you don’t have someone to bounce ideas off of or get feedback from. If you’re interested in helping, please do reach out! 

Additionally, I’m still making improvements to our application. I have finished a large rewrite of it that will allow for better language support. You’ll be able to preview this effort in today's update! Simply go to the options menu and select Russian from the new Languages option, and you'll be able to get a taste for how we imagine it working going forward. The other major features that I have lined up for the immediate future are adding the option of using a two-page view, the ability to save your place, controller support, and hopefully finally(!) getting windowed mode to work correctly on Windows. As always, please let me know if you find any issues with the latest build.

Meanwhile, while our artists are on a well-deserved break, Ross is working on writing the script for Chapter #3, which brings us to another announcement…

Restructuring Chapters

Those of you who have listened to the Commentary we made about the creation of Chapter #1 know that we try to be pretty transparent in talking about the mistakes we have made. This process has been a huge learning experience for us, and we continue to learn more and more every day. 

So, with that in mind, let’s talk about another mistake we made.

When we first decided on six chapters, it was before we had even written the script for Chapter #1. We had a rough outline for the overall story, and figured we would flesh out each chapter as we came to it and they’d have varying page lengths. This sounds reasonable in theory, but has also resulted in the situation where we’ve been planning on Chapter #3 to be 80 pages. 

While this is a great chunk of story, the big problems with this are that it means you all would have to wait at least a year to read it, and it also runs the risk of burning out our artists since it becomes a massive project. These are both things that we find unacceptable.

Instead, what we’ve decided to do is retool our idea of Chapters: A Place in the West will no longer be 6 chapters, but will be “some number of chapters that fit what we’re trying to do”. Each chapter will instead be roughly an equal length (~25-30 pages), and we’ll release multiple chapters per year… like an actual comic. This does not change the amount of content or story, so don’t think we’re just trying to milk it for length - it’s simply a restructuring of how much we release, when we release, and how we approach chapters. 

We want to get more into your hands sooner, and we feel like this is the best way for us to do that. In our prior approach, the plan would be that we’d work on Chapter #3 for all of 2017 and you’d get it sometime Q2 of 2018. Instead, now the plan is that you'd get Chapters #3 and #4 later this year, and Chapter #5 in Q2 of 2018.

Because this leads to some uncertainty as to how many chapters we’ll have, I’ve changed the app slightly to no longer give the names or numbers of future chapters. To give you a rough estimate, it will be something around 13 chapters, with the plan now to release 3 per year, instead of 1 large chapter.

Again, it doesn’t particularly affect the total amount of content, nor the time that the entire run will take, but is primarily a change in distribution.

Going to paid DLC

We know that this decision will be polarizing and we want to talk openly about why we’ve decided to make the comic’s later chapters be paid DLC. The simple reason is, it goes along with having smaller chapters as a way that we can get the comic to you faster. Making comics is expensive - all told, the production of Chapter #2 alone was over $25,000. While this isn’t a big number for a studio, it’s important to remember that this has been funded entirely by Ross and myself from our personal finances. 

This has increased the time we’ve needed to take off between chapters while we build back up our savings before starting production again. With researching in the industry and looking at our own download numbers for Chapter #1, we’ve tried to find a price point where the comic doesn’t feel expensive, yet also gives us the opportunity to be able to speed up production. 

As previously stated, future chapters will be in the 25-30 page ballpark, in keeping with the traditional comic book chapter format. Chapter #2, on the other hand, is 50 pages. Whilst we do think there is a natural break in the second chapter, we have opted not to split it into two to accommodate the new format, and release the full 50 pages. Future chapters will be the same price, but with Chapter #2 there will be more content, which we think is a nice way to introduce you to the DLC model. 

Finally

This is by far the biggest release we've done, considerably larger than our initial launch, and we want to apologise once more for our failures at meeting the announced deadlines or keeping up with communication. 

We do read everything that is posted or emailed to us, even if we don't always reply, and your feedback is instrumental in the future of Half-Life: A Place in the West. Please do let us know how you feel about the changes, and most importantly, Chapter #2!

notes.title: Chapter #2: A Very Modern Major-General Released!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26319859/ddcd0c827c40a59d11e90642570ab87dc0c93b98.png

Hi everyone,

We are incredibly excited to release the second chapter of the fan-made comic Half-Life: A Place in the West, titled “A Very Modern Major-General” today as DLC. We sincerely apologise to readers for the unexpected delay last month, but at the 11th hour we were taken by surprise when Valve granted us use of the Half-Life license. This means that, starting with the second chapter, A Place in the West will now move into a paid DLC model. 

The hopefully minimal price tag is intended to alleviate our production costs - for further elaboration on this point, do scroll down. We cover it quite extensively! We’d like to thank Valve for the opportunity, and we hope our readers will embrace the change, too.

We have also made the first 5 pages of Chapter #2 available for free as a teaser. The app will automatically update to make those accessible.

"A Very Modern Major-General" picks up where the first chapter left off - we rejoin Leyla Poirier, Albert Kempinski and the vortigaunt Dreyfus as they enter the strange city of New Franklin. Introducing a host of new characters and fresh intrigues, this chapter comes in at 50 pages and includes 5 new achievements!

The second chapter has been the result of a year of work, and has involved several changes to our team. Our artist from Chapter #1, Heath Heil, has stepped back to focus on raising his daughter. While Heath still did the penciling for chapter #2, he was also joined in this chapter by Ivan Miranda on inking, Ester Salguero on colouring, and Javier Puga for lettering. We also had the pleasure of working with Jiedi Chen and Daniel Gerhard last summer on some additional art which makes its appearance in this chapter. 

So, please, go and read it, and as always, let us know what you think. 

What are we working on now?

I’m continuing to champion our work on translating the comic and working with some very talented people to make the comic available in more languages. Because of the amount we are translating (80+ pages!), we unfortunately don’t have anything to release quite yet, but I can assure you that we’re working on getting these updates prepared. We still have a considerable amount of lettering to do, but my hope is that by early Summer we’ll have at least the following languages released: Brazillian Portuguese, Czech, Turkish, Spanish, and of course the Chapter #2 updates for Russian.

This is not by any means all of the languages we’re working on - we have others which are in varying states of completion. This also does not mean that we are not still looking for more people to help out. Many of the languages we’re hoping to support only have one person working on the translations and it’s very difficult to do since there is both a lot to be done and you don’t have someone to bounce ideas off of or get feedback from. If you’re interested in helping, please do reach out! 

Additionally, I’m still making improvements to our application. I have finished a large rewrite of it that will allow for better language support. You’ll be able to preview this effort in today's update! Simply go to the options menu and select Russian from the new Languages option, and you'll be able to get a taste for how we imagine it working going forward. The other major features that I have lined up for the immediate future are adding the option of using a two-page view, the ability to save your place, controller support, and hopefully finally(!) getting windowed mode to work correctly on Windows. As always, please let me know if you find any issues with the latest build.

Meanwhile, while our artists are on a well-deserved break, Ross is working on writing the script for Chapter #3, which brings us to another announcement…

Restructuring Chapters

Those of you who have listened to the Commentary we made about the creation of Chapter #1 know that we try to be pretty transparent in talking about the mistakes we have made. This process has been a huge learning experience for us, and we continue to learn more and more every day. 

So, with that in mind, let’s talk about another mistake we made.

When we first decided on six chapters, it was before we had even written the script for Chapter #1. We had a rough outline for the overall story, and figured we would flesh out each chapter as we came to it and they’d have varying page lengths. This sounds reasonable in theory, but has also resulted in the situation where we’ve been planning on Chapter #3 to be 80 pages. 

While this is a great chunk of story, the big problems with this are that it means you all would have to wait at least a year to read it, and it also runs the risk of burning out our artists since it becomes a massive project. These are both things that we find unacceptable.

Instead, what we’ve decided to do is retool our idea of Chapters: A Place in the West will no longer be 6 chapters, but will be “some number of chapters that fit what we’re trying to do”. Each chapter will instead be roughly an equal length (~25-30 pages), and we’ll release multiple chapters per year… like an actual comic. This does not change the amount of content or story, so don’t think we’re just trying to milk it for length - it’s simply a restructuring of how much we release, when we release, and how we approach chapters. 

We want to get more into your hands sooner, and we feel like this is the best way for us to do that. In our prior approach, the plan would be that we’d work on Chapter #3 for all of 2017 and you’d get it sometime Q2 of 2018. Instead, now the plan is that you'd get Chapters #3 and #4 later this year, and Chapter #5 in Q2 of 2018.

Because this leads to some uncertainty as to how many chapters we’ll have, I’ve changed the app slightly to no longer give the names or numbers of future chapters. To give you a rough estimate, it will be something around 13 chapters, with the plan now to release 3 per year, instead of 1 large chapter.

Again, it doesn’t particularly affect the total amount of content, nor the time that the entire run will take, but is primarily a change in distribution.

Going to paid DLC

We know that this decision will be polarizing and we want to talk openly about why we’ve decided to make the comic’s later chapters be paid DLC. The simple reason is, it goes along with having smaller chapters as a way that we can get the comic to you faster. Making comics is expensive - all told, the production of Chapter #2 alone was over $25,000. While this isn’t a big number for a studio, it’s important to remember that this has been funded entirely by Ross and myself from our personal finances. 

This has increased the time we’ve needed to take off between chapters while we build back up our savings before starting production again. With researching in the industry and looking at our own download numbers for Chapter #1, we’ve tried to find a price point where the comic doesn’t feel expensive, yet also gives us the opportunity to be able to speed up production. 

As previously stated, future chapters will be in the 25-30 page ballpark, in keeping with the traditional comic book chapter format. Chapter #2, on the other hand, is 50 pages. Whilst we do think there is a natural break in the second chapter, we have opted not to split it into two to accommodate the new format, and release the full 50 pages. Future chapters will be the same price, but with Chapter #2 there will be more content, which we think is a nice way to introduce you to the DLC model. 

Finally

This is by far the biggest release we've done, considerably larger than our initial launch, and we want to apologise once more for our failures at meeting the announced deadlines or keeping up with communication. 

We do read everything that is posted or emailed to us, even if we don't always reply, and your feedback is instrumental in the future of Half-Life: A Place in the West. Please do let us know how you feel about the changes, and most importantly, Chapter #2!

notes.title: Patch Notes for 1.6
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We hope you’re enjoying the Charnel House release. We just wanted to give a small update today. First of all, thank you to everyone who has left us comments about the video commentary. Per feedback we’ve received, this update moves the commentary video into optional DLC to keep the base app size more reasonable. Also included is a tweak to the code to make the achievement unlocks respond more appropriately, which should resolve issues with those as well.

Additionally, we want to give an idea of what the next few months will hold. 

Ross is going to be leading production of Issue 2. We are currently at 30 / 50 pages inked, and ~25 of them are coloured. December holidays may slow us down somewhat, but we’re certainly still on track for a release in January! Ross is also continuing to write and edit and rewrite the script for Issue 3, which should be going into production in March/April.

Meanwhile I will be continuing to work on Application improvements, as well as getting a new Translation team off the ground to work on localisation for the comic, app, and store page, which should expand our language offerings to 10+! I am still on the lookout for more people, so please do drop us a line at aplaceinthewest@gmail.com if you’re interested in helping out.

We want to thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to bringing more content to all of you in 2017.

notes.title: Update 1.5: The Charnel House
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26319859/742fadbe387a1a948e2e31dfc59b9c3e8c5e67db.png

We are incredibly pleased to announce the release of Update 1.5, dubbed “The Charnel House”. In addition to containing application updates as the previous updates have, this release marks our first so far that contains additional content since we first launched in late September. We are still on track to release Issue 2 in January, and there will likely be more tweaks to the app in between, but we didn’t want to go for too long without giving you something new and interesting to tide you over. Hopefully this lives up! 

The Charnel House is a three-page short that focuses on the character of John Moore, taking place a few hours after the events of Issue #1, Following Portents. Pencilled and inked by Heath Heil, it introduces two new members of our team: Ester Salguero (colourist) and Javier Puga (letterer), so it should nicely bridge Issue #1 and Issue #2!

This update also includes the following:

New Content
 The Charnel House: A new 3-page short story set in the world of Half-Life: A Place in the West!
 A 2+ hour video commentary about the making of Issue 1, including script excerpts, concept art, and comic pages in various stages of completion (rough sketches, pencils, inks)
 We’ve added a new background menu.
 Dreyfus’s speech bubbles in Issue 1 have all been changed in both the English and Russian to better reflect his alien nature.

New Features
 Six new achievements!
 The credits page has been remade, as our team has grown considerably.
 The options page now contains a volume setting for the background menus.
 The options page now displays all available keyboard shortcuts.
 Added more keyboard shortcuts.
 The zoom range has been expanded for further exploring the detail of the pages.
 Volume and Zoom Settings now save between sessions.
 Sounds for clicks and hovers have been added to the main menu.

Bug Fixes
 Scrolling via the keyboard is now much smoother.
 You should no longer be able to get into a broken state by interrupting animations.
 Background audio should now fade correctly.
 Resolved issue where arrow keys sometimes didn’t work.

Extras

We’ve created a Combine font! This font is derived from the typography around the Combine Adviser’s neck.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26319859/02f231ee754c689d8205dd4df2e7bfaa5d584e42.png

You can download the TTF here and use it for whatever your heart desires. No credit is necessary (since we didn’t design the original language), but we’d love to see what you come up with using it! If you make Half-Life fanart with it, shoot us an email at aplaceinthewest@gmail.com or a twitter mention (@halflifecomic) and we’ll include it in a future update.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26319859/a21bc5cf76ef1aeafe229c3d551f3b3a3eb08acf.png

A Quick Note on Virus Warnings

Please be aware that we have added a plugin to our application called Greenworks which is what the app uses to connect to Steam (since our app is not written in C++ and cannot access the API directly). We only use this for unlocking achievements. There are some instances where Avast will falsely detect a part of this plugin as containing a virus. This has been documented and is being worked on. 

We wanted to call this out ahead of time because we don’t want anyone getting the idea that there actually is a virus here. If you are in doubt, always take the necessary steps to protect your computer first and foremost. Let me know if this poses an issue for you and I’ll see if we can come up with a workaround in the meantime. I am really hoping to have this resolved before the release of Issue 2. 


A Quick Note on File Size

Adding the video commentary has increased the size of the application. Even compressed, the file comes to about 2gigs. This doesn’t sound like a lot when compared to some AAA release titles, but we’ve wanted to keep the app small and accessible, and it occurs to us that this may be too large for some users who may not be interested in the commentaries specifically - especially when considering that we may have commentaries for each issue! We are investigating some other options for handling this, such as maybe treating it as Free DLC. Please let us know how you feel about the size, content, whether it’s something you want more of, etc.

Last thing!

Finally, we benefit enormously from your feedback and do our best to factor it in for future releases so as ever, please do let us known what you think of everything, on either the Steam discussion board or via email: aplaceinthewest@gmail.com.

Thank you - and enjoy! We’ll see you again in January for Issue #2.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26319859/61e98a6bf387220b530e293f8c5bd17a5349441b.png

notes.title: Update 16 October
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We have received a lot of interesting feedback in the three weeks since we've launched on Steam, and we believe that going forward, further openness and transparency can only improve the comic.

To that end, we've opened up a thread on the discussion board where you can let us know what you'd like to see from the comic going forward, and more broadly, from comics on Steam. And of course, we will also keep you informed about what things we are working on. 

And speaking of things we are working on, we have an update planned for Halloween - in the form of new pages and more. We are also continuing to work on the remaining few bugs in the app itself, and we have a thread for reporting issues as well. 

We also wanted to share two wonderful pieces of fanart that have been sent into us. @RoyalSketchbook on Twitter has drawn a great Dreyfus, and Kenshi has made a really cool poster of the Ubdisha/Citadel.

notes.title: v1.1 Release!
notes.content:
Hi friends,

Ross and I are getting prepared to leave tomorrow for Steam Dev Days in Seattle, but I wanted to push this update out before we do.

Changelog

- BUG: Fixes a bug that occurs on some Macs where the menu is unusable.

- FEATURE: Adds the option of using Windowed Mode, as requested. Note that Windowed Mode may add some complications as far as browsing goes. It's far from perfect, and I'll be continuing to update it. 

Known Issues

The biggest outstanding issue is that there is still a problem that occurs on some instances of Windows where the game launches to a white screen. I have added a Discussion Thread which contains a workaround. Please report any new issues there that you find.

The Future

When Ross and I return from Seattle, I'll be diving back into trying to fix that Windows bug. I'll also be editing our audio track for the commentary and adding some fancy video to it, so that ought to be released in the next few weeks. We also have had some requests for more features on the app, which I'll be looking at adding (such as Controller support, maybe Achievements, some other things).

We also continue to be hard at work on the comic, continuing with production on Issue 2 as well as writing Issue 3.
